title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, default state, licensing and survey controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The full Cloud Policy path is documented across the two cited policy pages, and the notice-specific gaps about survey data are accurately scoped.

claims.claim: Microsoft Teams is introducing call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is introducing call quality feedback (CQF) surveys for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Users are periodically shown the survey after meetings end.
claims.quote: Users will periodically see a call quality feedback survey after meetings end on Teams Rooms on Android devices.

claims.quote: Does the change store new customer data?Yes. Users can submit call quality feedback through post-meeting surveys.

claims.claim: The Android release notes say survey results are visible in the Call Quality Dashboard.
claims.quote: These results are visible in the Call Quality Dashboard and can be controlled using [feedback policies](/en-us/privacy/microsoft-365/feedback/feedback-manage).

claims.claim: The feedback policy page says Microsoft acts as a processor for the tenant's feedback.
claims.quote: Microsoft acts as a data processor for your tenant's feedback.

claims.claim: The feedback policy page says collected user feedback is available in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: The feedback we collect from your users is available in the [Microsoft 365 admin center](https://admin.microsoft.com).

claims.claim: The feedback policy page lists Teams Rooms as connected to in-product survey policies.
claims.quote: | Teams Rooms | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

claims.claim: The feedback policy page does not identify Teams Rooms on Android separately.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms and Android in the opened Manage Microsoft feedback for your organization page; its table lists Teams Rooms without an Android-specific qualification.

claims.claim: No new identity, permission or sign-in requirement is documented specifically for these surveys.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys license price meter identity permission sign-in requirements. Read MC1490912, Android release notes, managing Rooms search excerpts and feedback policy pages; no new survey-specific requirement found.

claims.claim: The managing Teams Rooms documentation says surveys can appear for signed-in room accounts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts.

claims.claim: The affected audience is people participating in meetings on Teams Rooms on Android devices.
claims.quote: Users who participate in meetings on Teams Rooms on Android devices.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the existing Teams Rooms product licence requirement.
claims.quote: Each meeting room needs a Teams Rooms license, such as a Teams Rooms console, Surface Hub, or Teams panel. Teams provides two licenses for Teams Rooms: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro and Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic.

claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices should only be assigned Teams Rooms Basic or Teams Rooms Pro licenses (Teams Rooms legacy licenses are also valid).

claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys license price meter identity permission sign-in requirements. Read rooms-plan, rooms-licensing excerpts, Android release notes and MC1490912; no survey meter found.

claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "call quality" surveys license price billing. Read rooms-plan, rooms-licensing search excerpts, Android release notes and MC1490912; no survey-specific price found.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The documented work underlying the low cost assessment is device updates, communication, training and support preparation.
claims.quote:
Update Teams Rooms on Android devices to the latest supported application version through the Teams admin center.
- Inform users that they may be prompted to provide call quality feedback after meetings.
- Update internal training materials and support documentation as appropriate.

claims.claim: The Android release notes introduce Call Quality Feedback surveys in app version 1449/1.0.96.2026344105.
claims.quote:
### 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026)

Introduced in this update: [...] **Call Quality Feedback surveys:** Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings

claims.claim: The release notes date app version 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 to November 2026.
Microsoft warns that availability can vary by device make and model.
claims.quote: There can be a delay between when features are released by Microsoft and when they become available on a device make and model.

claims.claim: Teams Administrator is a documented role for managing devices in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To manage devices using the Teams admin center, you need to be assigned Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator roles.

claims.claim: Teams Devices Administrator is another documented role for managing devices in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To manage devices using the Teams admin center, you need to be assigned Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator roles.

claims.claim: The displayed Microsoft 365 Apps admin center route through policy creation and scope selection reaches the named in-product surveys setting.
claims.quote:
Under **Customization**, select **Policy Management**.
On the **Policy configurations** page, select **Create**.
On the **Start with the basics** page
On the **Choose the scope** page
On the **Configure Settings** page, select the policies

claims.claim: No PowerShell, Graph or other write API is documented for setting this Cloud Policy survey configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 PowerShell Graph API create update policy configurations survey; "Cloud Policy" "API" "survey". Read overview-cloud-policy, feedback-manage and Set-CsTeamsFeedbackPolicy; found no operation that writes this Cloud Policy setting.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Governance controls; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Cloud Policy survey controls apply to Teams Rooms in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts. To disable these surveys, use the Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy configurations apply to users rather than device objects.
claims.quote: Policies only apply to **user objects**.

claims.claim: The Android release notes explicitly link the new Call Quality Feedback surveys to feedback policies.
claims.quote: These results are visible in the Call Quality Dashboard and can be controlled using [feedback policies](/en-us/privacy/microsoft-365/feedback/feedback-manage).

claims.claim: Not Configured has the same effect as Enabled for the documented feedback policies.
claims.quote: When the following policies are set to **Not Configured**, it has the same effect as if you set the policies to **Enabled**.

claims.claim: The policy named Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft governs survey display and can be used to disable it.
claims.quote: | Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft | Controls whether surveys appear within product. |

claims.claim: Cloud Policy configurations are created and managed in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: To create or edit policy configurations you must sign into the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the Office Apps Administrator role for Cloud Policy management.
claims.quote: | Office Apps Administrator (**Recommended**) | This role can manage Office apps cloud services, including policy and settings management

claims.claim: Feedback policy changes can take a few hours to reach client applications.
claims.quote: After you apply policies, it can take a few hours for the client applications to update.

claims.claim: The roadmap record lists no US Government cloud, without asserting that such clouds are excluded.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The supplied notice does not specify who in the tenant can view individual survey responses.
claims.quote: Feedback will be used by Microsoft to improve Teams products and services.

claims.claim: Administrators can use the Teams admin center to review device status and software version information.
claims.quote: From Teams admin center, you can view the overall status of all devices in your organization and view details of each device individually. [...] and software version information.
